links.outcome: LLM versus regex method accuracy for gout detection against gold standard on same paragraphs
links.effect: LLM outperformed regex, achieving 92.7% PPV, 96.6% NPV, and 95.4% accuracy for gout.
links.quote: The LLM-based algorithm outperformed the regex method, achieving a 92.7% [88.7-95.4%] positive predictive value, a 96.6% [94.6-97.8%] negative predictive value, and an accuracy of 95.4% [93.6-96.7%] for gout.

links.outcome: LLM performance robustness across model parameters and prompt structure
links.effect: LLM framework performed well over a wide range of parameter values.
links.quote: The LLM framework performed well over a wide range of parameter values.

screen.reason: The study evaluates an open-weight LLM (Llama 3 8B) for retrospective disease phenotyping from French EHR text compared to regular expressions and evaluates prompt strategies, but does not test organizational deployment practices or safeguards.
